summary: ACDE #248 决定推迟原定 10 月 26 日的 Hoodi 上 Glamsterdam 激活，以研究 EIP-8037 与主网合约的交互，新日期未定。起因是 ChainSecurity 的分析：状态 gas 储备、即时退还和重新定价会让“失败后靠剩余 gas 判断是否 OOG”的合约逻辑失效，已发现 13 个真实案例。同日 EIP-8453 解耦共识发布初稿，EIP-8141 修补了可被中继方填充签名的计费漏洞。

items.title_en: EIP-8141: commit to elided signature lengths
items.note_en: Was merged (lightclient). Brett pointed out on Magicians that the raw bytes of empty-msg signatures are elided from the sig hash but still billed, so any relayer could pad an arbitrary signature and make the payer pay for it; after the fix, the payer's charge is fully determined by the sig hash.

summary_en: ACDE #248 decided to postpone the Glamsterdam activation on Hoodi, planned for October 26, to study EIP-8037's interaction with mainnet contracts; no new date was set. The trigger was ChainSecurity's analysis: the state gas reservoir, immediate refills and repricing can break contract logic that infers an out-of-gas failure from the gas left afterwards, with 13 real-world cases found. The same day, EIP-8453 decoupled consensus published its first draft, and EIP-8141 fixed a billing hole that let relayers pad signatures.
